name: Blown-down Pine Tangle
description: A war-blast/storm blow-down: a fallen Scots pine trunk with two side branches, dead needle clusters, a charred scorch band, and scattered bark chips — low crouch cover for the forest-steppe and pine-bor biomes.

parts.name: Main fallen pine trunk — mid-span cylinder
parts.note: r=0.17 m (0.34 m diameter); lies along Z (axis='z'); centre-y = r so bottom touches y=0.

parts.name: Butt-end widening — thicker section near the stump
parts.note: r=0.22 m; centre at z=-1.30 so butt spans z -1.50 to -1.10, overlapping the wide end of trunk. Slightly taller centre-y keeps bottom at y=0.

parts.name: Exposed heartwood at the snap end
parts.note: Pale wood disc at +Z snap end; straddles trunk cap at z=1.50 (no coplanar flat face on cylinder).

parts.name: War/fire char strip on left trunk flank
parts.note: Thin bevelBox embedded 4 mm into the left side of the trunk (outer x face at -0.17 = cylinder edge — curved vs flat, no coplanar z-fight).

parts.name: Primary scaffold branch — right side (+X)
parts.note: axis='x' → branch lies along X; centre shifted to +X so tip reaches x=+0.85.

parts.name: Secondary branch — left side (-X)
parts.note: Lies along X; tip reaches x=-0.70.

parts.name: Terminal twig off branch1
parts.note: Thin twig at far end of branch1 zone; barkDark reads darker than main branch.

parts.name: Dead needle cluster — branch1 end
parts.note: Dry rust-orange needle mass resting on/over branch1.

parts.name: Compressed soil exposure under trunk
parts.note: Thin ground-contact strip; does not extend under bark chips (no XZ overlap → no bottom-face z-fight).

parts.name: Bark fragment — right side
parts.note: Outside groundSoil.x range (0.50 > 0.275) — no coplanar bottom-face overlap.

parts.name: Bark fragment — left side
parts.note: Outside groundSoil.x range (-0.50 < -0.275) — no coplanar bottom-face overlap.

needs: Scots pine stem taper rate (cm/m) from a forestry reference — trunk_diameter_fallen and butt_diameter are taper-derived estimates (dossier#trunk_diameter_fallen, dossier#butt_diameter)
Primary branch diameter at junction for mature Scots pine — current 0.16 m is a rule-of-thumb estimate (dossier#branch_diameter_primary)
Blown-down trunk section length — current 3.0 m is a design estimate (dossier#design_estimate)
